title: Your history and your drives, in Chat
summary: Import your Codex and Claude history, and give chats context from your company drive.

highlights.title: Import Codex and Claude history
highlights.body: Bring local Codex and Claude conversations into Matrix from Settings or the CLI. They arrive as private chats with their full history.

highlights.title: Company drive context in Chat
highlights.body: Browse your company drive, then let a chat read the files you choose. Chats tied to a drive are grouped together, and you control what they can see.

items.text: Choose which organization you're working in.
Sharing is easier to use in the browser and in the desktop app.
Chat replies fade in as they stream on mobile.
Onboarding and the provider picker fit smaller windows.
Private chats show where files live on your Matrix computer.
Apps your agent builds get a clear visual style, smoother motion and better charts.
Your Matrix computer checks each update before installing it.
App windows in the desktop app fill their frame without gaps.
Installed apps open from the desktop app again.
Chats in Supervised mode can ask your saved agents for help.
Sharing a folder from an archived project works.
Organization memberships stay up to date.
App builds that hang are stopped cleanly.
